target_customer: Fintechs, banks, lenders and other companies in Latin America that need access to end-user financial data and bank payments
problem: Latin American banks keep financial data siloed and offer no open banking infrastructure, so developers must build many separate integrations to access user data.
business_model: Usage and subscription based API platform for financial data and later payments

founders.name: Pablo Viguera
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch (May 2020) describes him as previously COO at Verse and a former general manager at Revolut.

founders.name: Oriol Tintore
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch (May 2020) describes a former NASA aerospace engineer who founded Capella Space while pursuing a Stanford MBA.

competitors.name: Plaid
competitors.what: US bank data API that Belvo was compared to as its model; acquired by Visa in January 2020, not a Latin American competitor then
competitors.traction_then: Visa deal valued at $5.3B per TechCrunch

technical_complexity.rationale: Required building and maintaining connectors to many bank systems with no public APIs, with security and reliability demands, in a region lacking open banking regulation.

defensibility.rationale: Breadth of institution integrations and customer integration create switching costs, but connectors can be replicated by funded rivals such as Prometeo (founded 2018 per directories) and later regulated open finance.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition by incumbents found. Belvo acquired Skilopay in April 2023 and stayed independent.

market_need_then: In July 2019 Belvo described over 600 million people in Latin America, a booming fintech sector and an absolute lack of open banking infrastructure, with banks reluctant to open data unlike Europe under PSD2.

branding.domain_note: Uses belvo.com; acquisition history of domain not found.

identity.logo: Wordmark, refreshed in a new visual identity launched around February 2026
identity.visual_style: Infrastructure oriented, mature look after the 2026 rebrand
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and benefit focused, short headlines

branding.brand_signature: Think Plaid for Latam positioning line

rebrands.why: To reflect growth into more mature, reliable infrastructure per the company blog

brand_strength.rationale: Recognized in Latin American fintech press and by top customers like Nubank, but no evidence of brand driven virality or community.

pivots.to: Data plus payments (direct debit in Mexico, Pix in Brazil)
pivots.why: Company site now lists payments products; date approximate and not sourced

outcome_analysis: Belvo is active and raised $10M seed in 2020, a $43M Series A in 2021 and a $15M round in 2025 from top regional and US funds. Founders had fintech and aerospace backgrounds and chose the Plaid for Latam wedge when open banking infrastructure was absent. The 2023 funding squeeze led to layoffs of roughly 27 people, and the later smaller round suggests a slower period, but the company reports 80 million connected accounts and expanded into payments.
notes: Education of Pablo Viguera not found. CB Insights labels the 2025 round Series B; no company or press source states that, so stage is other. TechCrunch (2020) states total raised of 13M including a prior round, unclear whether pre-seed; no separate pre-seed round was found. Founding post of July 2019 names only Viguera as co-founder, but YC page and TechCrunch list both. Competitor list is thin: Prometeo and others lacked dated sources at the batch. 2024 payments date is approximate.
